CLASSES YOU MAY USE (nothing else): hdr brand nav eyebrow poster h2 h3 lede small btn btn-o btn-t price pick dot chip rule progress steps card row band timber slot hair col grow cen in ic pl on. - hdr: header row (flex, space-between). brand: serif brand name. nav: row of links. - eyebrow: small capitals label. poster: huge serif product name. h2: section headline. h3: card title. lede: grey intro line. small: grey small line. - btn: solid ink button. btn-o: outlined button. btn-t: text link. Put icons inside: . Icon names allowed: menu message-circle phone map-pin arrow-right ruler check clock instagram plus chevron-down. - price: serif price. pick: a size/preset button (add class "on" for the chosen one). dot: fabric colour dot, give it style="background:#hex" (placeholder colours only), class "on" for chosen. chip: fabric chip holding a dot and a label. - rule: hairline. progress: hairline with inside. steps: row of , class "on" on the current. card: column. row: flex row, space-between. - band: dark band wrapper (full width). timber: bordered card inside a band. hair: short timber rule. col: flex column. grow: flex-grow 1. cen: centred text. - slot: an empty picture slot. Always exactly:
. Put NO text inside it. Never draw furniture. Never use svg. - Inline style is allowed ONLY for layout: width, height, display, flex, grid, gap, margin, padding, position, top, left, right, bottom, text-align, align-items, justify-content, flex-direction, overflow, border-radius, background colour of a dot. No fonts, no colours elsewhere, no font-size. TEXT RULES: copy every quoted text EXACTLY. Anything in square brackets like [Brand name] stays exactly as written, brackets included. Never invent a name, price, product, address or number. British English. No em dashes or en dashes. No comma before and, or, but. No emoji. LAYOUT RULES: Phone: content is CENTRED, buttons are full width, the content area is 390 wide and 756 tall, so keep it inside 756px with nothing clipped. Tap targets at least 44px tall. Return ONLY one fenced html code block with the fragment. THE FRAME: SECTION 2 HERO. Top: a hdr row (menu icon left, brand "[Brand name]" centre, message-circle icon right). Then a centred column inside .in: eyebrow "[Category] · [Timber] · [Fabric]"; poster "[Piece name]" centred; then a relatively positioned block 350px wide and 210px tall holding a slot (data-label "Hero photo: the piece in a calm room" data-size "1600x1200", width 100%, height 210px) with a second small slot class "slot" (data-label "Pencil drawing" data-size "1200x1200", width 96px, height 96px, position absolute, right 8px, bottom 8px) overlapping its bottom right corner. Then a centred lede "Buy it ready. Or build it yours." Then a full width btn "Ready to buy · from LKR [price]" and under it a full width btn-o "Build your own" with the arrow-right icon after the text. Stack with 12px gaps.
